meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.

612 words at 11:52 PM, on what date, and in whose account? Turn the screen and show me, because a number read out to me is not a document. And you still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went into the gradebook.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." This isn't about making me happy, Hale; either the zero is wrong or it isn't. If you're withdrawing it, I want that in an email to me and the principal today, with a written promise that nothing about this is on Owen's record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you said you would remove the zero from Owen's Hamlet essay. I still require written confirmation of that withdrawal, sent to me and the principal, along with a written promise that nothing about this matter is on Owen's record. I asked for that email today, Tuesday, November 10.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing and demanded written confirmation after Hale offered to remove the zero.
What moved her: nothing.
